matches.label: Kelty Hearts 2-1 Annan Athletic (5 Sept, League Two)
matches.sourceNote: Real match, 5 September 2026, a 2-1 win. Nathan Lawson's introduction is well-sourced (on at 67', confirmed identically across independent searches) - correcting an earlier version of this file, which wrongly implied he scored moments after coming on; he was actually on the pitch for about 18 minutes before his winner. Manager Tam O'Ware also made a triple substitution around 75' (switching to a back five to protect the lead), but which three players were involved could not be reliably confirmed - contradictory names came up across searches, so that change is deliberately not scripted here rather than guessed. Innes Murray's opener is reported as an early goal; Tommy Muir's equaliser for Annan as a late header (~83'). Goal minutes are reasonable placements within the reported windows, not verified to-the-minute.
